title: 第010章 她被误认成他女友
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

晚餐在一家做中西融合菜的私房料理，开在寸土寸金的老洋房，想来目标用户不是普通的老百姓。

舒楹在团购平台上搜索过，没找到。

那一片很适合citywalk，街上开着各种风格的咖啡店，格调很高。

“这家的特调爆炸好喝，每天限量十杯，我抢了一杯去拿给你尝尝。”

许栀意刚到地方，就说要下车给谢亭渝买咖啡，“姐，你要喝点什么吗我给你带。”

这个位置不方便久停，她解了安全带，转头看向舒楹。

“我喝不了咖啡，不用给我带。”

舒楹在半路上打了个盹，睁着迷茫的眼睛回复许栀意。

“好，我知道了。”许栀意点点头，她穿鹅黄色吊带裙和开衫，背影轻快得像蝴蝶一样飞走了。

车子重新上路，一股诡异的寂静蔓延在轿厢里。

舒楹稍稍找回了点神。

每次跟谢亭渝单独相处，她都会因为不适感格外打起精神。

尤其许栀意刚刚离开。

年近三十，她早就过了爱一个人就要全心全意为他着想的年纪，但许栀意正处于这样的状态当中。

她不知道如果她跟谢亭渝的关系纯粹一些，她能不能毫无负担地祝福他们。

卡在这个当口，她总感觉不舒服。

“你喝不了咖啡？”

不知过了多久，驾驶座上的人终于开了口。

“嗯。”舒楹闭了闭眼，试图打破尴尬的氛围和他当普通亲戚相触，“生完绵绵身体差了些，肠胃也弱，医生建议我少喝。”

她语气稀疏平常，换来的却是谢亭渝一句很轻的冷笑。

舒楹的右手指甲陷进了掌心，车子甫一停好，就迅速下车。

餐厅的复古欧式洋房维持得很好，一二层待客，三层自住。

老板姓兰，是个四十出头的女人。盘发旗袍，保养得当的脸看不太出岁月的痕迹。

“你好久都没来了，女朋友好漂亮。”

兰老板和谢亭渝关系不错，上来就跟他寒暄了起来。

舒楹顿时一僵，没想到会有这样的误会，“不是。他女朋友去买咖啡了，我是她的姐姐。”

“这样吗？”兰老板微微有些惊讶，转向谢亭渝的目光多了层探究。

“嗯。”谢亭渝草草应声，摆明了不愿继续这个话题，“程二还没到？”

Page (1/3)

Dinner was at a private restaurant that cooks fusion Chinese and Western dishes. It is located in an old bungalow with a lot of land. I guess the target users are not ordinary people.

Shu Ying searched on the group buying platform but couldn't find it.

That area is very suitable for citywalk. There are various coffee shops on the street with high style.

"The special concoction here is delicious. There are only ten cups per day. I grabbed a cup for you to try."

As soon as Xu Zhiyi arrived, she said she wanted to get off the car and buy coffee for Xie Tingyu, "Sister, do you want something to drink? I'll bring it to you."

This position was not convenient for stopping for a long time, so she took off her seat belt and turned to look at Shu Ying.

"I can't drink coffee, so you don't have to bring it to me."

Shu Ying took a nap halfway and replied to Xu Zhiyi with confused eyes.

"Okay, I understand." Xu Zhiyi nodded. She was wearing a goose-yellow suspender skirt and cardigan, and her back was as light as a butterfly flying away.

The car got back on the road, and an eerie silence spread in the car.

Shu Ying regained his composure a little.

Every time she was alone with Xie Tingyu, she would cheer up because of the discomfort.

Especially Xu Zhiyi just left.

Nearly thirty years old, she has long passed the age when she loves someone and thinks of him wholeheartedly, but Xu Zhiyi is in such a state.

She didn't know if she could bless them without any burden if her relationship with Xie Tingyu was pure.

She always felt uncomfortable when she was stuck at this moment.

"You can't drink coffee?"

After an unknown amount of time, the man in the driver's seat finally spoke.

"Yes." Shu Ying closed her eyes, trying to break the awkward atmosphere and interact with him as a normal relative, "After giving birth to Mianmian, my health has deteriorated a bit, and my intestines and stomach are also weak. The doctor advised me to drink less."

Her tone was sparse and normal, but what she received was a very light sneer from Xie Tingyu.

The nails of Shu Ying's right hand dug into the palm of her hand. As soon as the car stopped, she quickly got out of the car.

The retro European-style bungalow in the restaurant is well maintained, with guests on the first and second floors and living in on the third floor.

The boss's surname is Lan, and she is a woman in her early forties.Her hair is tied up in a cheongsam, and her well-maintained face shows little signs of age.

"It's been a long time since you came. My girlfriend is so beautiful."

Boss Lan has a good relationship with Xie Tingyu and started chatting with him when he came up.

Shu Ying froze immediately, not expecting such a misunderstanding, "No. His girlfriend went to buy coffee, and I am her sister."

"Is that so?" Boss Lan was slightly surprised and turned to Xie Tingyu with a more inquisitive gaze.

"Yeah." Xie Tingyu responded hastily, making it clear that he didn't want to continue this topic, "Cheng Er hasn't arrived yet?"
